TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

RuMId60vuPSrOcyNL4lyow.zh: 斯洛伐克南部科馬倫(Komarno)8-9月累計報告140例病例,仍有4起群聚疫情持續,多發生於校園,該地區於今年年初即發生疫情,8月出現新一波疫情;當局已匡列1,577名接觸者,並加強疫苗接種及環境清消等措施。
RuMId60vuPSrOcyNL4lyow.en: In Komárno in southern Slovakia, 140 cases were reported cumulatively in August and September. Four cluster outbreaks are still ongoing, mostly in schools. The area had an outbreak at the beginning of this year, and a new wave appeared in August. Authorities have identified 1,577 contacts and strengthened vaccination and environmental disinfection measures.

kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.

FBitBdrbCago6Zr8D9yJag.zh: 斯洛伐克報告1例死亡病例,為11歲男童,6月上旬曾至瓦達什溫泉渡假村參加游泳課程,6/14因中樞神經系統受損住院,17日死亡。當局已預防性關閉渡假村,另採集105件水樣中,有10件檢出阿米巴原蟲,惟仍在確認是否為福氏內里阿米巴。
FBitBdrbCago6Zr8D9yJag.en: Slovakia reported one death, an 11-year-old boy who attended swimming lessons at the Vadaš thermal resort in early June. He was hospitalized on 14 June with central nervous system damage and died on 17 June. Authorities have preventively closed the resort. Of 105 water samples collected, 10 were positive for amoebae, and it is still being confirmed whether they are Naegleria fowleri.
